I told Pree in the DM that their cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October, which is next Wednesday.

I got the date from our DM history, not from gbrain. Pree's 14 October message says 21 October, and they haven't given a different date since. The gbrain lookup returned nothing, even though the private fact I saved on 14 October should still be there. It's probably a limit of this connection: the recall tool's description says remote callers only get facts visible to everyone. That means my private saves can't be relied on to come back in later sessions. For now the DM history is the dependable record. Saving the fact with everyone-visibility would make it come back, but it would also expose a DM detail to other people, so I haven't done that.
